title: Forming a peptide bond
caption: The carboxyl group of one amino acid condenses with the amino group of the next, releasing water and forming a peptide bond, –CO–NH– (shaded). The new chain has a free amino group at one end (N-terminus) and a free carboxyl group at the other (C-terminus).
alt: Glycine and alanine react to give the dipeptide glycylalanine, with the peptide bond shaded, and a molecule of water.
description: The carboxyl group of glycine joins the amino group of alanine: a peptide bond.
A molecule of water is released: a condensation reaction.
The dipeptide has a free –NH₂ (N-terminus) at the glycine end and a free –COOH (C-terminus) at the alanine end.
